pr_body_excerpt: Daily README update: Latest News and star history. Recent Apps is refreshed when an app is published.

gist.headline: The README blooms again
gist.blurb: The project front porch got its daily sweep: fresh Latest News, refreshed recent apps, and a newly inked star trail. Even the graphs need watering.
gist.summary: Updated the public README's Latest News and Recent Apps sections, alongside the light and dark GitHub star-history charts, for September 20, 2026.
gist.impact: Visitors can see the current project news, recently published apps, and up-to-date community growth history directly from the repository homepage.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy repository garden noticeboard represents the refreshed README: new news clippings, tiny app cards, and a pair of light/dark star-history charts growing like constellations. Polli, wearing a tiny librarian cap, pins the updates beside flowers and a code-plant while warmly admiring the growing star trail.
